reviewPolicy: This is a census of subject/source relationships, not a final original-image archive
The human editor reviews only after source-photo resolution, framing, correct physical original identity, legal reuse and artistic quality screening
Historical original painting approvals remain with earlier owner files and must not be overwritten by this ledger
Allow rotation across approved distinct originals only after user approval; never count alternate photos of the same painted object as different originals
Preserve standalone saints in composite feast as partial research until all saints are accounted for in compliant iconography
No rejected artworks reintroduced and no El Greco, Fra Angelico or Prado
